blocks.text: Waves ka diffraction rukawaton (obstacles) ke tez kinaron ya konon ke gird waves ka mudna (bend hona), ya kisi rukawat ke aage waves ka phail jana hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab wave kisi rukawat ya surakh (slit) se guzre jis ka size wave ki wavelength ke qareeb ho. Wavelength jitni lambi, phailao utna zyada; aur wavelength chhoti, to phailao kam.

blocks.alt: Rukawat mein ek jaisa gap, do khaake. Baen: qareeb qareeb seedhe wavefronts (chhoti wavelength) gap se guzar kar thora sa phailte hain: Small wavelength, Small diffraction. Daen: door door wavefronts (lambi wavelength) chaure aadhe daire bana kar phailte hain: Large wavelength, Large diffraction.
blocks.caption: Slit se diffraction (PDF page 157): chhoti wavelength, kam diffraction; lambi wavelength, zyada diffraction (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gap wahi hai, sirf wavelength badli hai. Jitni wavelength gap ke muqable mein lambi, utna lehar mur kar phailti hai. Isi liye awaz (lambi wavelength) darwaze ke gird mur jati hai magar roshni (bohat chhoti wavelength) nahi.
Diffraction har qism ki waves mein dekha ja sakta hai: pani ki waves, sound waves, light waves aur electromagnetic waves.

items: Konon (corners) ke peeche ya darwaze ke raaste awaz sun lena, chahe awaz kahin aur paida hui ho, kyunke sound waves konon ke gird mud jati hain.
Crystals se X-rays ka diffraction, kyunke crystal mein atoms ki baqaida qataron ka darmiyani faasla X-rays ki wavelength jitna hota hai.

blocks.text: Diffraction waves ke rawayye (behaviour) ka bunyadi hissa hai aur mukhtalif shobon mein is ke bohat se amli istemal hain.

Fig. 7.11 mein ripple tank dikhaya gaya hai. Yeh bohat kaam ka aala (apparatus) hai: is se pani ki waves banai jati hain, aur waves ki khasusiyat jaise reflection, diffraction aur refraction bhi dikhayi jati hain.

blocks.alt: Ripple tank: chaar tangon wale frame mein sheeshe ke tale wali pani ki tray. Stand ki lakri ki patiyon se elastic bands par latka vibrator pani ki satah ko chhoota hai. Stand par lagi lamp oopar se roshni dalti hai aur neeche farsh par safed screen par lehron ka pattern banta hai. Labels: Lamp, Stand, Vibrator, Water surface, Elastic bands, Frame, Glass bottomed tray, Leg, Wave pattern on screen, White screen.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.11: Ripple tank (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ripple tank mein pani, ek vibrator (jaise motor se hilne wali sui), rukawatein (jaise chhota mustateel block ya aadhi gol deewar) aur mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps hote hain. Vibrator se concentric (ek markaz wale) daire ya parallel (seedhi) waves banti hain. Rukawat rakh kar ek khaas chaurai ka gap banaya jata hai, aur tajruba mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps ke saath dohraya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Rukawat ke gap tak aate seedhe wavefronts, do khaake. Baen: tang gap, aage lehrein aadhe dairon mein phailti hain: Small gap, Increased diffraction. Daen: chaura gap, aage lehrein zyada tar seedhi, sirf kinaron par mudti hain: Large gap, Decreased diffraction.
blocks.caption: Tang gap, zyada diffraction; chaura gap, kam diffraction (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke sath chhape khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ripple tank mein lamp ki roshni lehron ke crests aur troughs ka saya neeche safed screen par dalti hai. Gap wavelength ke barabar ya chhota ho to lehrein khoob mudti hain (aadhe daire); gap bara ho to lehrein seedhi guzarti hain.

Dekha jata hai ke jab gap ki chaurai wavelength ke muqable mein chhoti ho to diffraction zyada hota hai aur waves rukawat ke gird mud kar aadhe daire (semicircle) jaisa pattern banati hain. Jaise jaise gap wavelength ke muqable mein chaura hota hai, diffraction kam hota jata hai aur waves kam mud kar gap se guzar jati hain.
Yeh tajruba ripple tank mein gap ki chaurai ka diffraction par asar dikhata hai, aur batata hai ke gap ki chaurai aur wavelength ka taalluq waves ke rawayye par kaise asar dalta hai.

blocks.caption: Gap ki chaurai aur diffraction (khulasa)
rows: numayan diffraction; waves mud kar aadhi gol shakal mein phailti hain
thora diffraction; waves kam mud kar guzarti hain

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye (For your Information)
blocks.text: Ek bareek diffraction grating se white light ka diffraction: white light mukhtalif rangon mein phail jati hai (kitab is ki tasveer dikhati hai).

blocks.title: Example 7.6
blocks.problem: Ripple tank mein ek wave generator 10 s mein 500 pulses banata hai. Pulses ki frequency nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: n = 500 pulses, t = 10 s; f = ?
Ek pulse ka waqt (time period): T = t/n = 10 s/500 = 1/50 s = 0.02 s.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat (Interesting Information)
blocks.text: Compact disc (CD) par bohat bareek lines (rulings) hoti hain, har ek 0.5 μm chauri; yeh diffraction grating ka kaam karti hain. Jab white light ka chhota source disc par parta hai to diffracted light rang daar patiyan (coloured lanes) banati hai, jo in lines ke diffraction patterns ke milne se banti hain.

blocks.prompt: Waves ke diffraction se kya muraad hai, aur ripple tank kis maqsad ke liye istemal hota hai (short question 7.7; MCQ 7.11)? Hum kone ke peeche kisi ko sun kyun sakte hain magar dekh kyun nahi sakte?
blocks.explanation: Diffraction rukawaton ke gird waves ka mudna aur wavelength ke qareeb size ke surakhon se un ka phailna hai. Ripple tank pani ki waves banata hai aur reflection, refraction aur diffraction dikhata hai; mukhtalif chaurai ke gaps se dikhata hai ke tang gap waves ko khoob phailata hai aur chaura gap mushkil se. Sound ki wavelengths (centimetres se metres) darwazon aur konon ke qareeb hain, to sound un ke gird mudti hai, jabke light ki wavelengths (taqreeban 0.5 μm) kahin chhoti hain, to light mushkil se mudti hai.

items: Diffraction: rukawat ke kinaron ke gird waves ka mudna aur surakh se aage phailna; surakh wavelength jitna ho to zyada.
Lambi wavelength, zyada phailao: awaz konon ke gird mud jati hai; crystals X-rays ka diffraction karte hain.
Ripple tank: chhota gap, zyada diffraction; bara gap, kam diffraction.
Example 7.6: 10 s mein 500 pulses, f = 50 pulses s⁻¹.
